title: Pure Substances & Mixtures
notes:
Pure Substances vs Mixtures

Elements: 118 known, classified into Metals, Non-metals, Metalloids.
Compounds: Chemically combined in fixed weight ratios (e.g. CO vs CO₂).
Mixtures: Variable ratios, homogeneous (1 phase) or heterogeneous (2+ phases).
summary: Elements, compounds, homogeneous and heterogeneous mixtures.
